scientific_rationale: Bind Analyst's local patch L093 exactly: typed_slots [8,12,22] with typed_elements [C,N,C], atom_slots [8,12,18,21,22], anchor A:VAL:116:N at [23.21,-27.476,7.3]. Enabled terms only: endpoint weight 0.4, half weight 0.3, type weight 0.3; orientation weight 0.0 is inactive and is not described. Direct geometry loss acts on all atom_slots including context neighbor 18; only typed_slots receive type loss. Context neighbor 18 is directly constrained by enabled geometry terms; atoms outside atom_slots have no direct loss but may respond through global model-mediated gradients. Type reward reads selected decoder N/C log probabilities; gradients act only on current coordinates through real coordinate and atomic-decoder Jacobians. No affinity differentiation, no discrete-label override, no graph freezing, no SMC. The intervention is satisfied: slot 22 is the N site (native_acceptor=true, donor-facing match 0.951096646394086 to A:VAL:116:N), and slots 8, 12, 21 are measured C-preferred (N_minus_C -0.41363633333333283, +0.30675144444444413, -0.23290522222222343), giving at least two measured C-preferred sites alongside N rather than rewarding N everywhere. This is a joint local swap with compensating_C_slots [22], not a global N-count constraint. Source distinction preserved: exchange_class is neutral degree-two pyridine-type aromatic N / aromatic CH, with pyrrole [nH] and amide N excluded; the generated N decoder channel is treated as generic N until final chemical-role checks. Terminal N/C labels are not asserted as chemical identities at a noisy intermediate time; counterfactual layouts are scored label hypotheses on fixed coordinates, not an observed continuation state or a promised score. Expected observable changes: local relaxation within 0.15 A per-step and 6.0 A cumulative RMS dose, final_local_geometry_rms_A comparable to incumbent 0.5070406612812871 and cumulative_control_RMS_A near 0.59747314453125; type term partially rewards identity preservation but does not enforce it, so local_NC_identity_accuracy and aromatic_N_role_fraction must be measured as outcomes. Final affinity is primary; validity, failure, strain and actual local N/C response must be reported.
